result.title: Many Plans at Once: Diverse Top-Quality Planning in Continuous Time
result.summary: Planners for physical systems usually return a single trajectory, which leaves no alternative when an unmodeled constraint invalidates the chosen route or downstream preferences change. A set of plans computed in advance provides ready-made alternatives and warm-starts for fast adaptation, but only if the plans are both low-cost and mutually distinct. Discrete planning addresses this with top-quality and diverse planning, but these ideas do not transfer to continuous time, where every valid trajectory has infinitely many valid near-copies, and existing trajectory planners converge to one or a few solutions. We present Many Plans at Once (MPAO), which treats every plan it finds as a reason to search elsewhere: it samples untrained neural networks whose outputs meet the boundary conditions by construction, trains corrections shared by networks from the same distribution, stores every validated plan, and adapts its sampling to what it has found, which makes it anytime. We define the goal by bringing the cost bound of top-quality planning and the distinctness threshold of diverse planning to continuous time. Under equal budgets against five baselines, MPAO is the only method that solves all 40 instances across four domains. On contact-rich manipulation, it is the only method with plans within 25% of the best known cost on one task, and returns about ten times as many such plans as the strongest baseline on the other two.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MPAO，面向连续时间物理系统的多方案规划：采样满足边界条件、未经训练的神经网络生成轨迹，训练同分布网络共享的修正项，保存所有已验证方案，并依据已发现结果自适应采样，从而在给定预算内输出多个低成本且互相区分的方案。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「低成本加区分度阈值」的多假设保留、以新发现驱动再采样的 anytime 机制，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的多样性维持、候选证据筛选与动态计算/停止决策提供类比线索，尚需核查其标准能否对应推理状态而非仅轨迹空间。
